_why: Everything a member's version changes lives here. cut.py, shots.py and build.py read it. Times are SOURCE seconds in the take.
_note: All values below are placeholders / example values that show the shape. 'keep' ranges are examples: replace them with your own. This build expects exactly 3 backgrounds: bg1 = the opener (no mark), bg2 and bg3 = the pages you mark.

backgrounds._note: bg1: shown from 0 s. anchor = exact text near the top of the bit to show (the page is captured from its top).
backgrounds.anchor: Exact text near the top of the page

backgrounds._note: bg2: arrives on from_word. key = exact text to mark; mark = underline | circle-each | circle; drawn on mark_word.
backgrounds.anchor: Exact text just above the line you mark
Exact text just above the line you mark

_beats_note: Words that move the page and you. pullback_word: bg3 zooms back out (null = skip). punch_word / punch_end_word: hard 1.07 punch-in on you, released on punch_end_word (null = skip).
